title: ci(governed-surface-guard): the pull_request leg attributes governed rows by commit subject, so a subject naming an issue reads that issue's /reviews (404) and the early warning misleads
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills#2` seat (`session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn`, seat post #19287) from the os-dev-report on #26201 (comment 6426304526, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, class a), verified by the independent contract review on PR #26311 (comment 6426695557, ③ Boundary flags). The finding was noticed, not touched, by #26311; ⛔ not a claim.

**Origin:** `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` on `main`, `enumerateRows`: a row is attributed by `pullNumberFromSubject` first, and falls back to the event's own PR number only when the range holds exactly one commit. On the `pull_request` leg the payload already carries the PR number.
**Reader who acts:** the lane that owns `scripts/pm/**` (the guard script is the governed-surface enforcement file; `.github/workflows/**` is not touched by the fix as proposed).
**Suggested grade (triage grades):** p3 — the early-warning leg exits 0 by design, so the defect misleads a reader and refuses nothing; the queue leg is unaffected because the squash subject carries `(#PR)`.

**Who pays:** whoever reads the guard's `pull_request` check-run output to learn whether a governed PR carries its review record.

**Measured:**
- PR #25965, main-line script: its single commit's subject names issue 25770, so the leg attributes the row to 25770, reads `GET /pulls/25770/reviews` (404 on an issue number) and prints "the review list could NOT be read" for a PR that has reviews.
- PR #25813: four governed commits with no trailing `(#N)` print as unattributed rows.
- PR #26311's own `pull_request` range: three first-parent commits (the merge of `origin/main`, the pin commit, the workflow commit), none with a trailing `(#N)`, so every governed row is unattributed; and the merge commit's first-parent diff carries 141 paths `main` already landed, including the workflow file itself, into the forecast.

**Wanted:** on the `pull_request` leg attribute every row to the payload's PR number (the subject is a hint at most), and enumerate the diff against the merge-base rather than per first-parent commit so an `origin/main` merge adds no already-landed rows; the `merge_group` leg's attribution (squash subject `(#N)`) and its refusals unchanged, byte for byte. Pin both with self-test cases on the existing battery.

**Card-specific acceptance:** a `pull_request` run on a PR whose commit subjects name an issue number prints the PR's own review state; a PR whose branch merged `origin/main` prints only the PR's net rows; `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` green; the `merge_group` cases unchanged. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.

**Dedupe:** REST listing of every issue updated since 2026-10-01 (505 issues, open + closed), title and body grep for `pullNumberFromSubject`, `review list could NOT be read`, `queue guard pull_request leg`, `commit subject attribution` → 1 hit, #26201 itself (the card whose report found this); no open card asks for it.
